# Notice and Termination Provisions

This is a test fixture. Every clause below exists to exercise one behaviour of the
verifier, and the quotes in `adversarial.json` are written against it.

## 1. Convenience termination

Either party may terminate this Agreement for convenience upon sixty (60) days'
prior written notice to the other party.

## 2. Early termination fee

Customer shall pay an early termination fee equal to fifty percent (50%) of the
remaining minimum commitment as of the effective date of termination.

## 3. Refund of prepaid amounts

Provider shall refund any prepaid fees attributable to services not performed as
of the effective date of termination, except where Provider terminates for
Customer's uncured material breach.

## 4. Cross-reference broken across a line

The gross receipts test is applied as provided in § 1.448-
2(c) and in the related published guidance.

## 4b. A word broken across a line

Each party shall provide the other with reasonable assis-
tance in responding to any regulatory inquiry con-
cerning the Services.

## 4c. A compound word broken at its own hyphen

It shall be an unlawful employment practice for an employer to discriminate
against any employee because that employee has opposed on-the-
job harassment or has made a charge under this title.

## 4d. A statute cited by section

Notice of the charge shall be served on the respondent within ten days, as
provided in 42 U.S.C. 2000e-5(b) and 29 CFR 1601.14(a).

## 5. Typographic noise

The parties acknowledge that the “Services” are provided ‘as is’ — without
warranty of any kind, express or implied.

## 6. A provision that appears twice

Time is of the essence in the performance of this Agreement.

## 7. An unrelated clause

Nothing in this Section limits either party's rights or remedies at law or in
equity, all of which are cumulative.

Time is of the essence in the performance of this Agreement.

## 8. Rent, with a footnote marker

Tenant shall pay monthly rent of $1,500 to Landlord on the first day of each month,
together with a late fee of $500¹ for any payment received after the fifth day.

## 9. Renewal notice, stated negatively

Not less than thirty days before renewal, Tenant shall deliver written notice to
Landlord of its intent to renew or to vacate the premises.

## 10. Two deadlines in one sentence

The Supplier shall deliver within 30 days of the order and the Buyer shall pay within
60 days of delivery, in each case without set-off.

## 11. A floor, not a ceiling

The liability cap shall not be less than the fees paid in the prior twelve months
under this Agreement.

## 12. A notice right that is easy to misread

Tenant may give notice to terminate this Lease upon thirty days' written notice to
Landlord.

## 13. A regulation number broken after its en dash

The dollar limitation is set out in proposed § 1.163– 
16(h)(1) and applies to each return filed for the year.

## 14. A question answered in the FAQ style

Do I need a lawyer to send the notice? No. You do not need to hire anyone to send the
notice on your behalf.
